summary: This directory manages the core CRUD framework and data synchronization logic. It provides the essential infrastructure for mapping database schemas to application data models and executing standardized persistence operations across the system.
responsibilities: Defining generic repository interfaces for data operations
Deriving repository implementations from schema definitions
Calculating synchronization requirements for data records
Validating keys against database table structures
Managing entity metadata and structural schemas
relationships: Repository interfaces utilize schema definitions to structure data operations performed on database tables.
Synchronization logic compares entity states to determine necessary database mutations.
Repository types are derived directly from the underlying schema definitions to ensure type safety.
designDecisions: Use of generic interfaces for modular CRUD operations
Separation of schema definitions from operational logic
Type-safe validation of table keys against data schemas
